messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy finished to eu-west-2 — rollout v3.2.11 started (canary 10% -> shadow parallel). Initiating post-deploy smoke + shadow synthetic run now.

synth-bot: SHADOW SYNTH ALERT: KV probe error rate = 1.9% (baseline 0.2%). p50 +5ms, p95 +40ms. running samples=2k

alex: Hmm okay. Is this only in shadow or do canaries see it?

synth-bot: canary error rate 0.15% (within baseline). anomaly isolated to shadow pool (eu-west-2b shards 10-14).

sahil: Thanks — that points to a node-level/placement thing. Are there any recent infra changes? autoscaler, kernel?

maria: I see a spike in memcached evictions around 03:14Z on those shards (observability link: https://dash.redwood/s/kv-evicts). Could be TTL pressure.

jen: Did the runtime config change for cache TTL in this rollout? I don't think so but checking release notes now.

oncall: infra-alert: autoscaler bounced 3 nodes in eu-west-2b at 03:12Z due to OOM events — correlated with deploy timeframe. Logs show heavier GC.

synth-bot: log snippet: `ERROR kv_timeout key=embed_cache shard=12 timeout=250ms` repeated 120x over 30s

alex: My proposal: PAUSE the rollout, pin canary at previous stable (v3.2.10) for safety, and run a config patch to bump cache TTL +50% in shadow then rerun synth. If metrics improve -> unpause. If not -> rollback plan. Thoughts?

sahil: Agree to pause. I don't love immediate rollback unless patch fails. TTL bump is low-risk and can be toggled quickly.

maria: Confirmed TTL is a runtime toggle (`runtime.kv.embed_cache_ttl_secs`). We can change via config service without full deploy. No change window needed for emergency patches but will annotate.

jen: I'll prepare the release note snippet and action log entry: "hotfix: temporary embed_cache TTL bump to mitigate post-deploy evicts"

oncall: I'll also widen alert thresholds and monitor error >0.5% for 30m. Set pager if sustained.

alex: Decision: hold rollout (canary pin to v3.2.10), apply TTL +50% in shadow, run 10k-sample shadow synth. Criteria: if error rate drops <0.5% and p95 improves <+20ms, unhold and continue gradual rollout. Else, rollback canary to v3.2.10 cluster-wide and open incident.

synth-bot: ACTION: hold enacted by @alex. canary pinned. Shadow patch started by @sahil.

sahil: Patch applied to shadow shards at 03:22Z. Starting rerun (10k samples).

synth-bot: POST-PATCH RESULTS: samples=10k, error rate=0.28%, p95 +12ms. No memcache evict spikes post-patch.

maria: Nice — within acceptance. Recommend unhold and resume gradual rollout with 15m cooldown and close monitoring.

jen: Release notes updated with TTL tweak and rollback threshold. I'll add a note to changelog for auditors.

oncall: I'll keep watch for 30m and escalate if >0.5% or OOMs reappear.

alex: Thanks all. Resuming rollout in 5m with cooldown. Closing this thread if green. :thumbsup:
